summary: Implemented and repaired T7 deterministic distill/review/model-artifact behavior: canonical signature clustering, capped confidence for thin evidence, signature-only provenance, weak/strong memory rendering, review approve/edit/reject transitions, no auto-acceptance of generated drafts, mandatory resolvable PR receipt URLs on memory rules, offline local model manifest recording, stale/digest fail-closed local embedding validation, and ADR/docs coverage for the local embedding boundary.
